steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: GCSE RS requires you to understand Christian and Muslim teachings about sexuality, including heterosexual and same-sex relationships, and sex before and outside of marriage. | RS Exam Tips — Human Sexuality and Relationships: 1. For Human Sexuality and Relationships questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of Human Sexuality and Relationships to its real-world impact on believers and society | UK Context: In the UK, debates about often involve both religious and secular voices. Parliament
